sentences.text: This petition has been filed to quash the proceedings in S.T.C.No.613/2016 based on the complaint filed by the Food Safety Officer for the offences under Sections 48 and 59(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard the learned counsel for petitioners and the learned counsel for respondent.
3.

The main contention of the learned counsel for petitioners is that there is a violation of Section 42 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the notice has not been given at the time of lifting the sample and also no opportunity has been given to have a second sample analysis.
4. On the contrary, it is the case of the prosecution that the very same complaint itself indicate that at that time of lifting the sample itself, notice was served as per Section 42 of the Act.

Therefore,
whether the notice has been served or not while lifting the sample is a factual aspect, which cannot be gone into by this Court at this stage and this Court https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis cannot make a rowing enquiry.
Therefore, this Court does not find any material to quash the case pending in S.T.C.No.613/2016 on the file of Judicial Magistrate III, Salem.
5. Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
